verdict_scope: Source-supported fidelity of the supplied standard-core summary to the original manual and the scoped official FAQ. This is not an unconditional playable-core completeness certification.

scope.included: Original Nemesis, basic board, six original characters, standard semi-cooperative core; official FAQ v2.2 dated 16.04.2025 base-game Rules/Actions/Rooms/Items, printed pp.2–4.
excluded: All expansion rulings, FAQ printed pp.5–6

method.pdf_verification: Compared original-PDF text for scoped pages with source-snapshot extraction, checked PDF-only no-Search notes on pp.25–26, visually inspected embedded Basic/Room Action cost icons and Combat die symbols, and verified p.23 recipe-icon pairings by their PDF positions. Read FAQ PDF printed pp.2–4 as well as its extraction.

source_limitations.case: All eight Adult miniatures already in Combat when another Adult must appear
source_references: Original manual p.15, Additional notes about Intruder movement
source_limitations.evidence: The prescribed remedy removes only Adults not in Combat, then instructs placement. It supplies no model or alternative outcome when all eight are in Combat.
source_limitations.summary_handling: Accurately disclosed in Encounters and Source limitations.
source_limitations.needed_for_unconditional_completeness: Publisher clarification of that exhausted-model state.

source_limitations.case: Queen bag development adds an Egg after Nest destruction
source_limitations.evidence: Development can add an Egg when no Character is in the Nest, while zero Eggs has marked the Nest destroyed. The supplied scoped sources do not expressly settle restoration of the destroyed state/marker.
source_limitations.summary_handling: Accurately disclosed without declaring restoration or permanent destruction.
source_limitations.needed_for_unconditional_completeness: Publisher clarification of Nest status and marker after such an Egg is added.

source_references: Original manual p.19, normal Melee sequence
source_limitations.evidence: The Egg exception says the Character does not draw Contamination or suffer Wounds if they miss. Its grammar leaves the scope of the Contamination exception uncertain on a hit. The scoped FAQ does not resolve it.
source_limitations.summary_handling: States the supported missed-attack exception and flags the successful-attack case instead of inventing a general exemption.
source_limitations.needed_for_unconditional_completeness: Publisher clarification of Contamination on an Egg Melee hit.

source_limitations.case: Later Character death after first-death pod unlock has been reversed
source_references: Original manual p.12, First dead Character
source_limitations.evidence: The critical-moment rule specifies first death, whereas the pod section says any Character death. FAQ 25 resolves repeated yellow-space unlocks only; it does not settle repeated death unlocks.
source_limitations.summary_handling: The main procedure uses first death and expressly records the conflicting any-death text and unresolved later-death case.
source_limitations.needed_for_unconditional_completeness: Publisher clarification reconciling first-versus-any death after pods are re-locked.

source_limitations.case: Individual card and character-board text not fully reproduced in the manual/FAQ
source_references: FAQ scoped character and Item rulings
source_limitations.evidence: The manual delegates individual Action, Item, Serious Wound, Weakness, Objective and character-specific effects to their physical components. The provided PDF contains examples and the FAQ clarifications, not a complete card corpus.
source_limitations.summary_handling: Preserves printed-card dependencies and expressly directs readers to card text for unreproduced Action, Item and Weakness effects.
source_limitations.needed_for_unconditional_completeness: Access to the actual game components or an authoritative complete card-text source.

source_supported_fidelity.explanation: The material setup, Action costs/restrictions, ordered timing, movement/noise/encounters, damage, Room procedures, destinations, end conditions, and scoped FAQ corrections are faithfully represented. The four specifically disclosed source ambiguities are not counted as summary errors because the supplied authoritative material does not uniquely resolve them.

complete_core.explanation: The summary is a substantial core reference used with physical game cards, but it explicitly leaves four reachable source-ambiguous cases for authoritative clarification and does not contain a complete delegated card corpus. A fidelity PASS must not be relabeled as proof that every legal core-game state has a unique playable resolution.
complete_core.distinction: These are limits of the supplied authoritative material or an expressly retained component dependency, not evidence that the summary omitted an available authoritative resolution.

overall_conclusion: PASS for fidelity to the scoped sources, with no actionable source-supported correction identified. Unconditional complete-core coverage remains unproven for the precise limitations recorded above.
